novel_features.name: Round-trip precision report
novel_features.description: Convert a coordinate from A to B and back, and report the residual error introduced by the datum transform.
novel_features.rationale: A precision metric requires chaining two official transforms and computing the local residual; no single volapi call returns it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when you must certify a datum chain is lossless before publishing or depositing data.

novel_features.name: Valid conversion targets
novel_features.description: List which Italian reference systems are valid destinations for a given source EPSG.
novel_features.rationale: Filters the cached systems table and encodes the same-datum/identity edge the API rejects.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before converting to avoid picking an unsupported or meaningless destination datum.

novel_features.name: Reference-system inspection card
novel_features.description: Show datum family, axis order (e/n), units, UTM/Gauss-Boaga zone, and false easting/northing for an EPSG.
novel_features.rationale: A curated static-reference table over the 20 known EPSGs, joined to the cached IGM description.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to disambiguate look-alike systems (3003 vs 3004, 23032 vs 23033) before a conversion goes wrong.

novel_features.name: Coordinate-based source detector
novel_features.description: Guess the plausible source reference system of a coordinate from its magnitude and axis ranges.
novel_features.rationale: Pure-local heuristics over decimal-degree, Gauss-Boaga (~1.5M/2.5M easting), and UTM zone ranges; no API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a dataset is labeled vaguely ('UTM', 'Gauss-Boaga') and you must recover its real EPSG.

novel_features.name: Offline conversion cache
novel_features.description: Inspect or clear the local write-through cache of conversion results for offline, reproducible replay.
novel_features.rationale: Every convert/batch writes results to a local JSON cache keyed by (inEpsg,outEpsg,e,n); repeats are served instantly offline.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this in CI or offline pipelines where re-running the same conversions must not hit the live service.

narrative.headline: Official IGM coordinate transforms between every Italian reference system, from the command line, with zero grid-file setup.
narrative.value_prop: verto wraps the authoritative IGM Verto Online service (Roma40, ED50, IGM95, ETRS89, RDN2008) as a scriptable CLI. Convert one coordinate or batch a whole CSV/GeoJSON, list and inspect reference systems offline, detect a dataset's real EPSG, and measure round-trip precision -- all without installing licensed NTv2 grids and all with agent-native --json/--select/--csv output.
narrative.auth_narrative: No authentication. The service is free and open; the utente/chiave fields the API requires are placeholders, filled automatically.

quickstart.comment: see the 20 supported Italian reference systems (cached offline after first run)
convert one geographic coordinate Roma40 -> RDN2008
check axis order, zone and false easting before a projected conversion
batch-convert a CSV of Gauss-Boaga points to RDN2008/TM32

troubleshoots.fix: every coordinate needs both e (est/lon) and n (nord/lat); check your CSV column mapping with --e-col/--n-col.

troubleshoots.symptom: Converted points land far away / in the sea
troubleshoots.fix: wrong source EPSG or swapped axis. Run 'verto-pp-cli detect <e> <n>' to recover the likely system and confirm axis order with 'inspect'.

troubleshoots.symptom: Batch rejected for too many coordinates
troubleshoots.fix: the service caps at 32000 coordinates per request; batch auto-chunks, so re-run -- if it persists, reduce --chunk-size.

narrative.when_to_use: Use verto whenever you need the authoritative IGM transform between Italian datums from a script, pipeline, or agent -- single points, CSV/GeoJSON batches, CI jobs, or QA checks -- instead of the browser-only IGM web form or generic PROJ math that lacks the official grids.

recipes.title: Convert a CSV of cadastral points to RDN2008
recipes.command: verto-pp-cli batch catasto.csv --from 3003 --to 6706 --e-col est --n-col nord --out rdn2008.csv
recipes.explanation: Maps the est/nord columns, auto-chunks at 32000, writes a converted CSV.

recipes.title: Pipe a deeply nested GeoJSON conversion into jq
recipes.explanation: Reprojects FeatureCollection geometries and narrows the response to just the coordinate arrays for downstream tooling.

recipes.title: QA a datum chain before publishing open data
recipes.explanation: Reports the residual error of A->B->A so you can certify the transform is within tolerance.

recipes.title: Recover the real EPSG of a vaguely-labeled file
recipes.explanation: Heuristically identifies the likely source system from coordinate magnitude when the dataset just says 'Gauss-Boaga'.

trigger_phrases: converti coordinate da Roma40 a RDN2008
